1. Delay condoned.
2. Leave granted.

3. Feeling aggrieved and dissatisfied with the impugned judgment and order(s) dated 21.03.2022 &
02.08.2022 passed by the High Court of Punjab & Haryana at Chandigarh in RFA Nos. 6169 & 6381 of 2014 and 6083 & 6287 of 2014, by which the High Court has allowed the said Appeals, the co-owners of the land acquired have preferred the present Appeals.

sentences.text:
4. At the outset, it is required to be noted that with respect to the very acquisition, by a detailed judgment and order dated 20.10.2022 passed in C.A. Nos. 7516-7521 of 2022 - Jaspal Singh and Others vs. State of Haryana and Ors., this Court has determined and awarded the compensation @
Rs. 22 lakhs per acre.

sentences.text: 5. Therefore, the appellants shall also be entitled to the same compensation.

However, considering the fact that the judgment and award passed by the reference Court was not challenged by the appellants before the High Court and despite the fact that they were the proforma respondents before the High Court, the appellants shall not be entitled to any interest from the date of passing of the judgment and award(s) passed by the reference Court i.e. 30.03.2013, 29.04.2013 & 30.05.2013 till the impugned judgment and order(s) passed by the High Court i.e. 21.03.2022/02.08.2022.
6.
In view of the above and for the reasons stated above and for the reasons stated in the case of Jaspal Singh (supra), the present Appeals are allowed in part.

The appellants herein shall be entitled to the compensation @ Rs. 22 lakhs per acre at par with other landowners and as ordered by this Om Parkash vs The State Of Haryana on 17 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/85309662/

sentences.text:
However, the appellants in Civil Appeals @ impugned judgment and order passed by the High Court in RFA Nos. 6083 & 6287 are concerned, they shall not be entitled to any interest under Section 28 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 for the period between 30.05.2013 to 21.03.2022.
7.
The appellants shall be entitled to all other benefits which may be available under the provisions of the Land Acquisition Act,1894.
